title: Large-Capacity Industrial Storage Tank Manufacturing Project
summary: TONGYANG has been extensively involved in large-capacity industrial storage tank projects, supporting customized equipment manufacturing, engineering coordination, and project execution. body:
Project Overview

This project reference highlights TONGYANG's experience in manufacturing large-capacity industrial storage tanks for chemical, petrochemical, and industrial processing applications.

The equipment covers customized vertical steel storage tanks developed for different storage capacities, operating conditions, and material requirements.

Project Highlights

  • Industry: Chemical & Petrochemical

  • Equipment: Large-Capacity Industrial Storage Tanks

  • Tank Configuration: Vertical Cylindrical Storage Tanks

  • Materials: Carbon Steel / Stainless Steel / Customized

  • Tank Capacity: Project-Specific

  • Applications: Industrial Liquid Storage & Chemical Processing

Project Description and Tongyang's Role

TONGYANG has played a significant role in large-scale industrial storage tank projects, contributing to customized equipment manufacturing, engineering coordination, fabrication planning, and technical implementation.

Our involvement covers various stages of equipment-related project execution, including material selection, structural fabrication, welding, quality inspection, and transportation preparation.

Large-capacity storage tank projects require careful coordination of equipment dimensions, structural integrity, installation interfaces, and transportation requirements.

Through close collaboration with engineering and project teams, TONGYANG supports the successful delivery of customized storage equipment for demanding industrial applications.

These project references demonstrate TONGYANG's manufacturing capabilities and extensive participation in industrial storage infrastructure development, particularly in chemical and petrochemical facilities.
